title: The [TBD] Workshop in Marine Policy
text:
The Human-Ocean Systems Lab at the University of Miami will host the first [TBD] workshop in Marine Policy.
What: The event will provide marine policy researchers with the opportunity to share their work in a relaxed workshop setting where working papers are presented and discussed.
Who: Graduate students, faculty, and researchers from across academia, non-profits, and government agencies working on anything that touches salt water are welcome.
